title: The Final Graphs Are Small, and Density Varies Nearly Threefold
subtitle: Graph size after the 4-occurrence entity filter, three papers
caption: Density is 0.170, 0.328 and 0.121, and average degree is 6.11, 8.52 and 2.30. The SNORA64 paper has 20 nodes and 23 edges but ten communities, the largest with 5 nodes, so its graph is close to a set of small clusters. Edges are counted after GraphBuilder drops pairs whose endpoints did not survive the filter, so they are fewer than the merged edge count.
source: results/pipeline_measurements.json, from scripts/measure_pipeline.py, single run per paper
